identification: Pair of George III London sterling silver Old English pattern spoons, engraved crest (chevron arms) on the terminals. Marks seen in photo 2: maker's mark (PT or similar), crowned leopard head, lion passant, date letter, sovereign's head duty mark (so 1784 to 1890, Georgian by style). The spoons look long for teaspoons (possibly dessert size), so weight is unknown. Worth roughly silver weight plus a modest antique premium.
